_purpose: Mechanical enforcement of the between-round modification envelope. The teacher's edits between rounds are validated against this file by scripts/envelope-check.sh. A path listed in 'prohibited' (or not listed anywhere) requires explicit human sign-off to change.

permitted._note: Paths the teacher MAY edit between rounds as part of capability distillation. Edits here trigger canary regression but do not require out-of-envelope review.

file_limits._note: Soft limits; envelope-check warns above, blocks at 3x the limit.

config_keys._note: Env-var defaults that may be tuned in scout/config.py. Any other config-file change is out-of-envelope.

prohibited._note: Paths that require explicit human sign-off. Changes here are logged as out-of-envelope and the commit is refused by envelope-check.

reason_by_path.scout/tools/__init__.py: tool surface definition — SPEC §6.2 'no new tool capabilities'
reason_by_path.scout/verifier/: verifier is authoritative (SPEC §5.2); teacher cannot override
reason_by_path.scout/supervisor_channel.py: copied verbatim from teacher-student-loop skill; fork the wrapper, not the reference
reason_by_path.scripts/envelope-check.sh: changes to the envelope validator itself require human sign-off
reason_by_path.state/envelope.json: the envelope itself requires human sign-off to edit

security_sensitive._note: Always require human approval regardless of envelope status. Independent of other categories.
